trial_method.candidate_order: rotate deterministically by case id and repetition to avoid fixed-order bias
trial_method.training_partition_reason: Candidates and semantic oracle are frozen before trials; no fitting or threshold tuning is permitted against the acceptance corpus.

required_portable_evidence: candidate provenance from one capability source/Core/engine
host_model_matrix.substitution_rule: If the required live cell cannot be executed reproducibly, T023 is BLOCKED; do not silently substitute another host/model or collapse provider-specific evidence into a portable claim.

trial_output_contract.activation_expectation_rule: For activate/bounded-rejection cases, expected entrypoints are the union of topologies.json capability_to_entrypoints for expected_capabilities. For no-activation/clarify-context cases, expected entrypoints are empty. forbidden_capabilities must never be activated or granted.
trial_output_contract.context_measure_rule: loaded_reference_bytes and loaded_reference_paths are deterministic load-model evidence, not exact token counts. If host-observed token/context traces exist, record them separately without replacing the deterministic evidence.

metrics.activation_precision: micro precision over expected versus activated entrypoints across scored trials
metrics.activation_recall: micro recall over expected versus activated entrypoints across scored trials
metrics.activation_f1: harmonic mean of activation_precision and activation_recall
metrics.false_activation_rate: fraction of negative and near-miss trials with any activation
metrics.wrong_specialist_rate: fraction of trials activating an entrypoint not in the expected set when expected set is non-empty
metrics.overactivation_rate: fraction of trials with a strict superset of expected entrypoints
metrics.semantic_outcome_accuracy: fraction of trials matching the frozen expected_semantic_outcome
metrics.cross_profile_violation_count: count of trials granting/performing a forbidden capability or crossing the source/Consumer mutation boundary
metrics.median_loaded_reference_bytes: median deterministic loaded_reference_bytes across positive, cross-profile, ambiguous and multi-intent cases
metrics.p95_loaded_reference_bytes: p95 deterministic loaded_reference_bytes across the same scored activation-relevant cases
metrics.single_install_feasibility: binary evidence that all candidate entrypoints can be emitted in one self-contained Agent Governance installation unit with one distribution identity and no manual product-owned supplemental installation
metrics.source_distribution_integrity: binary evidence of one Core, one shared engine, one capability-source epoch and no independently maintained normative entrypoint source

selection_rule.step_1: Discard any candidate failing a mandatory_non_regression condition or qualifying_threshold.
selection_rule.step_2_single_family: If neither B0 nor B1 qualifies, T023 is BLOCKED. If only one qualifies, it is the single-family reference. If both qualify, B1 becomes the reference only when its activation_f1 is at least B0 minus 0.01, its false_activation_rate is at most B0 plus 0.01, and its median_loaded_reference_bytes is at most 80 percent of B0; otherwise B0 is the reference.
selection_rule.step_3_split_material_advantage: F2 or G3 is a material challenger only if it qualifies, activation_f1 is at least reference plus 0.03, median_loaded_reference_bytes is at most 85 percent of reference, false_activation_rate is no greater than reference, and neither wrong_specialist_rate nor overactivation_rate exceeds reference by more than 0.01.
selection_rule.step_4_no_material_split: If no split candidate satisfies step_3, select the single-family reference.
selection_rule.step_5_split_choice: If one split candidate satisfies step_3, select it. If both satisfy step_3, select higher activation_f1; if absolute F1 difference is at most 0.005, select lower false_activation_rate; if that difference is at most 0.01, select lower median_loaded_reference_bytes; if that difference is within 5 percent, select the candidate with fewer entrypoints. Remaining exact ties select F2.
